goal: Add an account-wide native AUX blacklist for all AuxVmangos automatic BUY/BID paths while preserving manual AUX purchases, and verify the existing post default remains stack size 1 for every character.
notes: Blacklist is stored in account-wide AVM_DB, filters AUX_ARB rows before candidate creation, and wraps PlaceAuctionBid only when the auction row matches an AVM automatic candidate. Existing AuxVmangos_PostDefaults already resets the selected Post stack-size slider to 1 after upstream item selection on every character, so no duplicate stack-default implementation is added.
